title: The Long Walk
description: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
description: A lavish trip through Europe quickly unfolds into a race against time to solve a murder aboard a train. Everyone's a suspect when Detective Hercule Poirot arrives to interrogate all passengers and search for clues before the killer can strike again.

title: Contagion
description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

title: The Bride!
description: A scientist revives a murdered woman as a companion for a legendary creature. The aftermath defies all expectations.

title: A Killer Story
description:
S01 E01 — Welcome to Topeka
When a double murder conviction is overturned with the help of two citizen sleuths, investigative journalist Joe Sexton digs into the case.

title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
description: A deep dive into the storied and complex legacy of "Ms." magazine through the lens of some of its covers.

title: In the Shadow of the Towers: Stuyvesant High on 9/11
description: Former students from Stuyvesant High School, located near the original World Trade Center in New York City, recall how the harrowing events of Sept. 11 shaped their lives.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E01
As the COVID-19 pandemic ravages New York, Spike Lee shines a light on the city's racial justice activists amid rising police violence.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E02
Spike Lee hears from New York lawmakers who were at the Capitol on January 6; a Queens nurse becomes the U.S.'s first COVID vaccine recipient.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E03
Spike Lee explores the attacks of 9/11, hearing from survivors, frontline workers, and boat captains who launched a historic maritime rescue.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E04
Though the city is united in grief in the wake of 9/11, health problems of first responders, persecution of Sikhs and Muslims underscore the impact of the tragedy; New Yorkers reflect on the hardships the city has faced.

title: Barbie
description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E01 — Valerie Gets a New Chapter
Valerie is offered a role on a new multi-camera comedy; stoked that sitcoms are on a comeback, she accepts, but is shocked to discover that the show is being written by artificial intelligence.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E02 — Valerie Has a Secret
Valerie attempts to out-improv the AI script, leading to a breakdown on set.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E03 — Valerie Faces Reality
A leaked clip from Jane's documentary goes viral for all the wrong reasons.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E04 — Valerie Does It All
Valerie Cherish is back; Lisa Kudrow stars as the determined former sitcom star trying to stay relevant in a changing industry filled with AI-written shows.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E05 — Valerie Lights a Candle
Valerie Cherish stars in a sitcom written by artificial intelligence, which presents her with bizarre challenges.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E06 — Valerie's Home Alone
Valerie finds herself alone amid a media meltdown after news of her AI written show is somehow leaked to the public; Val is further shocked to discover that a member of her team has not signed a NDA.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E07 — Valerie Chases the Truth
Valerie tries to repair the damage caused by negative AI press and save Mark's reality show job by making an appearance on "Finance Dudes."

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E08 — Valerie Cherish
Urged by NuNet to make a public statement in defense of AI, Valerie contemplates her future with or without How's That?!

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E01 — The Pilot
Teddy, Phil, Lilly, and Ronnie vow to figure out why so many kids have gone missing in Derry; Major Leroy Hanlon arrives at Derry Air Force Base, where he navigates a chilly reception from some of his fellow airmen.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E02 — The Thing in the Dark
Charlotte and Will navigate their new life at the town of Derry; Ronnie worries about her father's fate.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E03 — Now You See It
General Shaw pushes ahead with his mission, ordering Leroy and Pauly to escort Dick Hallorann on an aerial search for a new dig site; Rose attends a tribal meeting; Ronnie, Lilly, Will, and Rich attempt to get visual proof by conjuring an Orixá.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E04 — The Great Swirling Apparatus of Our Planet's Function
Children encounter frightening situations while Charlotte supports Hank and General Shaw increases pressure.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E05 — 29 Neibolt Street
After learning the truth about General Shaw's operation, Leroy decides to move his family to the base for safety; while the tribal Keepers strategize how to contain increased aggression in town, the military descends on Neibolt Street.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E06 — In the Name of the Father
Plagued by dark visions, Dick gets a surprise at the Black Spot; all the kids face their own challenges.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E07 — The Black Spot
A vigilante attack on the Black Spot unleashes long dormant forces; in the aftermath, Dick helps uncover another crucial artifact.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E08 — Winter Fire
A dense fog descends upon Derry as General Shaw presses forward with his mission; consequently, the Hanlons join forces with Rose, Dick and the children in a desperate attempt to protect their town.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E01 — Release the Brown Fat
Writer Greg Russo arrives at Ludlow College to support his daughter Katie as her marriage begins to implode.

title: Rooster
description:

When Katie's future at Ludlow is thrown into question, Walt offers Greg a deal to keep them both on campus.

title: Rooster
description:

Greg navigates his first day as a teacher at Ludlow, Katie deals with being suspended, and Archie assists Sunny in finding an advisor.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E04 — Angry, like an Angry Person
To avoid Walt's party, Greg dedicates himself to a student; with her suspension lifted, Katie considers one-night stands.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E05 — Mr. Razzles
Greg has to deal with his ex-wife visiting the campus; Katie grows closer to Archie and Dylan thrives in his role.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E06 — Cop Hawk
While relishing in his new fling, Greg offers Tommy a place to crash; Katie confronts the student behind some personal campus graffiti; Dylan impresses Walt in her new role; Sunny wrestles with a prestigious job offer.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E07 — All the Dogs' Names
Greg, Cristle, and Tommy attempt a return to normalcy, Archie meets Sunny's father; Walt makes Dylan an unsatisfactory new offer.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E08 — Nobody Spook It
While Greg tries to support an increasingly emotional Katie, Dylan attempts to steer a promising student towards poetry; Sunny is delighted when Archie starts to engage more with her pregnancy.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E09 — Ludlow's Fourth Hottest Professor
Greg motivates the hockey team before a game, Katie focuses on her internship, and Archie gets feedback on his book.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E10 — Songs for Raisa
After setting boundaries with her parents, Katie makes a decision about her marriage to Archie, who has his own talk with Sunny about the future; then, as he grapples with Katie's independence, Greg prepares to say goodbye to his semester.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E01 — Cornhole
When Clark and Floyd learn that both their marriages have stalled, they begin to explore a new dating app for extramarital affairs.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:

Detectives Homer and Plumb investigate Clark's affair with Carol and Floyd's use of a dating application.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:

When Detective Plumb discovers that Carol has lied about key details of her affair, she presses Homer to let her question Clark; once in the hot seat, unsettling truths about Clark's relationships with both Floyd and Carol begin to come to light.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E04 — Missouri Mutual Life & Health Insurance Company
A limited series about a love triangle between three adults experiencing middle-age malaise that leads to one of them ending up dead.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E05 — Amphezyne
Floyd confronts Clark about the affair; Plumb and Homer uncover new facts about Carol's past.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E06 — The Denny's Plan
Carol Floyd loses her confidence, so Clark helps her through the DTF app.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E07 — No One's Normal. It Just Looks That Way from Across the Street
After a series of revelations, Plumb and Homer question everything they know about the case.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E01 — Andale
A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her; hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous, to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E02 — America My Dream
Rue travels to Mexico and confronts displacement; Jules navigates art school pressures and reflects generational struggles.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E03 — The Ballad of Paladin
A group of childhood friends wrestle with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption and the problem of evil.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E04 — Kitty Likes to Dance
Rue is offered a risky deal that draws her deeper into Alamo's world; Nate battles the city council, Maddy gives Cassie a mission that could skyrocket her new career; Lexi enlists Jules to create an original painting for LA Nights.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E05 — This Little Piggy
Cassie and Maddy clash when the truth comes to light; Rue realizes she is in far too deep; Jules' relationship teeters on the edge; Lexi discovers her sister is once again threatening to invade her territory.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E06 — Stand Still and See
Maybe every mistake Rue made led her to the right place after all.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E07 — Rain or Shine
Under financial pressure, Maddy schemes to get Cassie back in the spotlight; Rue obsesses over the sign God gave her.

title: Euphoria
description:
S03 E08 — In God We Trust
Danger closes in on all sides as Rue's double-dealing finally reaches its breaking point; while the medical van speeds towards the border, Maddy and Cassie must band together and Alamo is struck by a life-changing epiphany.

title: Euphoria: A Look Back
description: Features interviews and behind-the-scenes footage of the show "Euphoria."

title: Half Man
description:
S01 E01
Ruben shows up unexpectedly at Niall's wedding; this surprise visit turns what should be a joyous occasion into chaos, leading to an eruption of violence that catapults back through the decades.

title: Half Man
description:
S01 E02
After struggling to fit in at university, an isolated Niall turns to Ruben for help, but his presence leads to devastating consequences.

title: Half Man
description:
S01 E03
1993. His mother asks Niall to lie in court about Ruben's violence, and he is conflicted. Ruben seems different now, so the decision weighs heavily on him.

title: Half Man
description:
S01 E04
When Niall's estranged brother Ruben shows up at his wedding, it leads to an explosion of violence that catapults us back through their lives, from the eighties to the present day.

title: Half Man
description:
S01 E05
Niall and Ava face major life changes as Ruben struggles with his relationship; An impulsive choice between Mona and Niall has serious consequences for all involved.

title: Half Man
description:
S01 E06
2014; Niall builds a new life, but old ties resurface when Mona reconnects with Ruben, forcing difficult choices.

title: Task
description:
S01 E01 — Crossings
Forced back into the field after a family tragedy, special agent Tom Brandis leads a new task force investigating a string of robberies.

title: Task
description:
S01 E02 — Family Statements
Tom's family prepares for an emotional court date; Robbie faces a dilemma; Maeve makes a crucial decision that might change everything.

title: Task
description:
S01 E03 — Nobody's Stronger Than Forgive...
As Cliff and Robbie look for a buyer, Aleah and Lizzie question Peaches' former co-workers; Tom and Grasso pursue a lead.

title: Task
description:
S01 E04 — All Roads
Tom questions the loyalty of his taskforce; Perry probes his own gang for answers and uncovers a shocking truth.

title: Task
description:
S01 E05 — Vagrants
With help from an eyewitness, Tom and his team inch closer to breaking the case; Perry pays Maeve a visit, while Robbie puts his plan in motion; later, Tom follows a lead that takes him down a dangerous path.

title: Task
description:
S01 E06 — Out Beyond Ideas of Wrongdoing...
The Task Force, Dark Hearts and Robbie converge in the woods, leading to a showdown with consequences for all involved; in the aftermath, Tom turns his attention back to his fragmented team as the bureau launches an investigation.

title: Task
description:
S01 E07 — A Still Small Voice
As the Task Force seeks answers and the Dark Hearts cover their tracks, a revelation leads them to a final confrontation.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

A century before the events of "Game of Thrones", a knight and his unlikely squire embark on an adventure.

Dunk appeals to various lords in order to gain entrance into the tournament, but Egg advises him to hold onto his pride; when the Targaryens arrive at Ashford, Dunk seizes his moment with Prince Baelor.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
description:
S01 E03 — The Squire
The truth about Egg's identity is revealed as Dunk invites danger by doing the right thing and preparing for the tournament.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
description:
S01 E04 — Seven
Dunk angers the Targaryens and demands trial by combat; when Aerion calls for a trial of seven, Dunk must find six knights to join him in battle.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
description:
S01 E05 — In the Name of the Mother
Dunk and his six knights face off against Aerion's forces in the trial of seven; Aerion knocks Dunk off his horse; Dunk sees flashbacks of his childhood on Flea Bottom.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
description:
S01 E06 — The Morrow
The people of Ashford mourn a significant loss following the tournament; Dunk reflects on his future and evaluates his responsibilities toward Egg; he decides whether to keep the boy as his squire.

title: Hacks
description:
S05 E01 — EGOT
Deborah deals with the fallout of her passing; Ava tries to manage the press.

title: Hacks
description:
S05 E02 — Number One Fan
The duo returns to the Palmetto to reclaim their territory.

title: Hacks
description:
S05 E03 — No New Tricks
Deborah Vance chases Madison Square Garden; Ava Daniels still nurses the sting of a drunken remark; the Deborah-Ava bond sitting in a tricky place between loyalty and emotional overreach.

title: Hacks
description:

Deborah is on the back foot as she runs a practice set for Ava, Jimmy, Kayla, Randi and Josefina, which goes down badly; Deborah blames the room, insisting it offers a different dynamic to that of a comedy club.

description:

When The Amazing Race announces a celebrity edition, DJ holds Deborah to her longstanding promise of partnering up; after Deborah gives her blessing, Ava attempts to secure the rights for her Who's Making Dinner? reboot.

description:

Now that The Diva goes over budget, Deborah meets with an investor, while Jimmy and Kayla try to attract a regular comedian.

description:

After choosing a very specific outfit for her show at Madison Square Garden, Deborah begs for the outfit.

description:

Deborah's show faces another obstacle when they request to start selling tickets, while Jimmy and Kayla receive a subpoena.

title: Hacks
description:

While Ava pitches her reboot, Deborah prepares to take the stage for the biggest show of her career, which looks much different.

title: Hacks
description:

As Ava embarks on a project, Deborah, Marcus and Marty officially open The Diva; Jimmy's role delivers exactly what they need.

title: The Pitt
description:
S02 E01 — 7:00 A.M
On fourth of July, Robby meets his replacement for his sabbatical, a no-nonsense attending from the VA; a familiar face returns to the Pitt.

title: The Pitt
description:

Distracted by her impending deposition, King suffers a fall; Al-Hashimi attempts to revolutionize the department's technology; Javadi sizes up the competition.

description:

After a motorcycle collision, a husband and wife are rushed to the ER; as King and Javadi deal with a bickering family, Santos is forced to check her assumptions about a possible case of child abuse; Robby bonds with a Tree of Life survivor.

description:

With a nearby hospital shuttered on the busiest day of the year, Robby and team must field extra patients, including the victim of a parkour mishap.

title: The Pitt
description:
S02 E05 — 11:00 AM
As patients continue to pour in, including a local prison inmate, Robby and Langdon must work together to save a beloved patient.

title: The Pitt
description:
S02 E06 — 12:00 P.M.
As the team deals with a loss, Al-Hashimi and Robby continue to clash over the best course of treatment for a patient showing signs of malnutrition.

title: The Pitt
description:
S02 E07 — 1:00 P.M.
While Dana tends to a sexual assault victim, Abbot helps an officer injured in the field, and Mohan attempts to keep her uninsured patient in the ER.

title: The Pitt
description:
S02 E08 — 2:00 P.M.
In the wake of an IT shutdown, Princess must manage a completely analog ER. Al-Hashimi, Mohan and King assess a woman with sudden blindness.

title: The Pitt
description:
S02 E09 — 3:00 P.M.
After one of Javadi's patients slips through the cracks, Dana calls in an old friend with experience running a low-tech ER.
